result.summary:
Implemented the new LRU behaviour in lib/lru.js (only file changed; tests untouched):
- Entries are now stored as { value, born, ttl } in the internal Map.
- peek(key): reads without refreshing recency; returns undefined for missing/expired entries.
- TTL: constructor option ttl (default) plus per-entry set(key, value, { ttl }) override; injectable now() clock (defaults to Date.now()). An entry expires when now() - born >= ttl (so it is valid up to but not including the ttl boundary, matching the tests). get/has/peek remove expired entries on touch; size and keys() purge expired entries first.
- onEvict(key, value, reason) callback with reasons 'capacity' (max overflow), 'deleted' (delete), 'expired' (lazy expiry), 'replaced' (set over a live key); only invoked when provided.
Verification: `node --test` from repo root → 7/7 pass, exit 0.
